verses.text: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.

segments.text: God is our refuge and strength,
A very present help in trouble.

verses.text: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be shaken into the heart of the seas;

segments.text: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change,
And though the mountains be shaken into the heart of the seas;

verses.text: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, Though the mountains tremble with the swelling thereof. [Selah

segments.text: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled,
Though the mountains tremble with the swelling thereof. [Selah

verses.text: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.

segments.text: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God,
The holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.

verses.text: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God will help her, and that right early.

segments.text: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved:
God will help her, and that right early.

verses.text: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved: He uttered his voice, the earth melted.

segments.text: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved:
He uttered his voice, the earth melted.

verses.text: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah

segments.text: Jehovah of hosts is with us;
The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah

verses.text: Come, behold the works of Jehovah, What desolations he hath made in the earth.

segments.text: Come, behold the works of Jehovah,
What desolations he hath made in the earth.

verses.text: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariots in the fire.

segments.text: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth;
He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder;
He burneth the chariots in the fire.

verses.text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.

segments.text: Be still, and know that I am God:
I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.

verses.text: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah

segments.text: Jehovah of hosts is with us;
The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah; set to Alamoth. A Song.
